## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive. VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -5.06% | 1M: -15.29%) ↓ falling and core ratios SPY_TLT NEUTRAL / HYG_LQD NEUTRAL provide conflicting signals, supporting the NEUTRAL read.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear easing signaled by VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -5.06% | 1M: -15.29%) ↓ falling; credit conditions stable with HYG ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.14% | 1M: +0.90%) → flat and LQD ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.03% | 1M: +0.40%) → flat. Narrow sector participation (Tech and Energy only) is the dominant constraint.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral: SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.47% | 1M: +2.68%) → flat while TLT CORRECTION (1W: -0.05% | 1M: +0.73%) → flat, with yield-curve metrics reported neutral across the board.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Tech showing strength: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.58% | 1M: +6.36%) ↑ rising and Energy also ABOVE TREND: XLE (1W: +1.35% | 1M: +7.41%) ↑ rising; breadth narrow (2/11) so Style mixed / no clear leadership despite tech strength.

5. US vs Global?
US marginally stronger: SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.47% | 1M: +2.68%) while Emerging Markets EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.38% | 1M: +4.57%) ↑ rising; China FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -0.51% | 1M: -3.10%) → flat and lagging.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculation remains alive: ARKK ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.97% | 1M: +20.12%) ↑ rising and IBIT ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.07% | 1M: +25.34%) → flat, while small caps IWM in CORRECTION (1W: -1.36% | 1M: +0.94%) signal selectivity.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Agriculture leadership: WEAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.14% | 1M: +16.80%) ↑ rising; industrial and metals mixed with CPER CORRECTION (1W: -0.17% | 1M: +1.11%) → flat and GLD CORRECTION (1W: -4.28% | 1M: +9.93%) ↓ falling.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy constructive: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.35% | 1M: +7.41%) ↑ rising and BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.11% | 1M: +4.88%) → flat; natural gas UNG ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.84% | 1M: +4.77%) ↑ rising.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Confirmed: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.58% | 1M: +6.36%) and QQQ ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.48% | 1M: +4.18%) show consistent tech strength; Minor divergence flagged as many asset ETFs (GLD, SLV, XBI, URA) are in CORRECTION (1W negative / 1M positive) but core ETF divergence is not yet MAJOR.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor selective exposure to tech and energy ETFs (XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.58% | 1M: +6.36%), XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.35% | 1M: +7.41%)) and reduce exposure to lagging pockets like FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -0.51% | 1M: -3.10%) and defensives XLU BELOW TREND (1W: -2.29% | 1M: -4.78%).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Technology XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.58% | 1M: +6.36%) and Energy XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.35% | 1M: +7.41%) if momentum holds. BEARISH: Utilities XLU BELOW TREND (1W: -2.29% | 1M: -4.78%) and Consumer Discretionary XLY BELOW TREND (1W: -3.11% | 1M: -3.38%) on narrow breadth.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Agriculture WEAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.14% | 1M: +16.80%) on strong flows. BEARISH: Gold GLD CORRECTION (1W: -4.28% | 1M: +9.93%) and Silver SLV CORRECTION (1W: -3.33% | 1M: +14.84%) for near-term profit-taking.

13. Key Levels?
VXX 20 (complacency pivot), HYG/LQD spread ~0.80 (credit health), XLK/XLF relative 2.0 (growth vs value pivot) — monitor these as regime tilt triggers.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive, conflicting signals from neutral ratios and a falling VXX. Tech and Energy showing relative strength (XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.58% | 1M: +6.36%), XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.35% | 1M: +7.41%)); key risk is narrow participation and multiple CORRECTION divergences in precious metals and select cyclicals to monitor.
